post_hoc_appendix.owner_observed_server_state: The owner reports LM Studio was not running at all during the failure window and was started afterwards. This is operator observation, accepted as information. The run logs under-record this condition because of the fail-open defects below — which is precisely why the observation could not be confirmed from logs alone.

fail_open_transport_defect_discovered.gateway_catch_all: backend/pipeline/gateway/gateway.py call() converts any provider/transport exception — including a fully unavailable endpoint — into LLMResponse(content='', degraded=True). One ERROR log line per call; upstream, indistinguishable from an empty completion.
fail_open_transport_defect_discovered.adapter_extinguishes_signal: GatewayProvider falls back to the inner provider on any exception and its returned LLMResponse has no degraded field — degradation state is lost at the adapter boundary.
fail_open_transport_defect_discovered.caller_level_fail_open: extract_json('') returns {} with a warning — where all ~20 'Empty LLM response' lines per failed run originate.
fail_open_transport_defect_discovered.startup_probe_non_authoritative: PipelineOrchestrator.run() does call LMStudioManager.preflight_check(auto_fix=True) and refreshes the capability registry, but preflight.ready == False logs 'proceeding with static defaults' and both checks' exceptions are downgraded to warnings — the system probes, can discover failure, and is deliberately coded to continue.
fail_open_transport_defect_discovered.false_succeeded: Finalization marks failure only for 0 gaps + 0 ideas + 0 proposals; the 3D shape (gaps>0, ideas=0) fell through to PipelineOutcome.SUCCEEDED. The qualification harness caught it externally via REQUIRE design == designed.
fail_open_transport_defect_discovered.classification_note: 3D's verdict is NOT rewritten to INVALID_ATTEMPT — the exact server state during the run is not reconstructible from the evidence, per the owner's ruling. The record now carries both the fail-open defect and the owner-observed server state.

post_hoc_appendix.q2_remediation_authorized: Owner-authorized single bounded Q1->Q2 generic correction: (1) fail-closed required-provider startup readiness (reuse the existing LM Studio preflight; typed failure before research execution); (2) preserve transport-failure identity through the gateway (typed error, no inner-provider fallback, no success-shaped empty); (3) close the false-SUCCEEDED invariant for autonomous runs. Explicitly out of scope: empty-rate thresholds, circuit tuning, blanket extract_json retries, new models. After Q2 is review-clean and CI green: re-freeze, criterion 12 pre-resolved, confirm the certified model live, one fresh zero-intervention attempt (diagnostic per the owner's four-outcome table).
